column5: GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/api/slot_metadata.rs:51-56`: no slot plan means empty metadata; not traced whether a requirement with a returned reference and no plan can exist.
GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/behavior/policy/receivers.rs:20-22`: a call whose authored expression is not a call node is skipped.

GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/callables/boundary_operators.rs:203-205` and `callables/boundary_requirements.rs:108-110`: `Ok(())` when no selected plan lists the machine; "an external leaf that is not a provider-selected realization is not joined to a plan at all".

GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - Missing identity text becomes `""` and is then compared or stored: `callables/boundary_operators.rs:141-143`, `callables/boundary_requirements.rs:92-94` ("an empty identity would equal an empty plan identity text"); `callables/external_supply.rs:164,169`; `contracts/expressions/static_arguments.rs:319-320,400-401`; `contracts/propositions/binders.rs:68-69`; `semantics/types/identity.rs:60,130` (a type "recorded with an empty identity rather than rejected").

GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/callables/surface.rs:199-200,264`: Build role with inferred ceilings yields no declared values; "open whether Build reaches are otherwise validated".

GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - Pass-through arms that leave a type reference unsubstituted: `calling/application/signature/instantiation.rs:227`, `semantics/conformances/policy_arguments.rs:190`; not traced which node kinds reach them.
GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/contracts/expressions/calls.rs:99-109`: only Borrow arguments are type-compared.

GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `zip` truncation: `package_policy/native_bindings.rs:21-26`, `runtime_permissions.rs:185-187`, `terminal_authority_permissions/declarations.rs:87-92`; lengths not shown equal.
